tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window and page background, behind cards and glass. Plain: never a gradient or colour blobs.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs and the tint of glass panes. Solid: content never sits on see-through ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, the off track of a switch, tiles inside a card.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The floating sidebar and the Settings list.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control outlines, hairlines between rows (in high contrast: every surface's outline).

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of quiet buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and titles on bg, surface, raised, sidebar and glass.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary words: hints under a setting, details under a title. On bg, surface and raised.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Least important words that still must be read: captions, section labels. On bg and surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action that matters, the chosen item, links, switches turned on, focus rings.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: accent while hovered or pressed.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal fills: the chosen tab or sidebar item, secondary buttons, the chosen segment.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Words and icons on accent.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Words and icons on accent-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Deleting, errors, overdue. Always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, saved, connected. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon: low battery, due today.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Big numbers and the one headline of a screen (a stat, a countdown).

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Sheet and dialog titles, a Settings section heading.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, list-row titles, setting names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text everywhere. Never smaller for anything the user must read.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: The smallest size: timestamps, section labels, small print. Never below 13px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its word; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a card; between a title and its hint.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: THE gap: between cards, between the sidebar and the page, and from every window edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding (inner things then round to radius-lg minus 12).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Settings card padding, a phone screen's side margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a page; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above a new page section.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Things inside a card: tiles, a pressed row (radius-lg minus space-3).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus' items, segmented buttons.

tokens.name: radius-popup
tokens.usage: Menus, drop-down lists, tooltips (glass).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Every outer surface: cards, the sidebar, the Settings list, floating glass bars, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Phone bottom sheets and the map sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: tab-bar selection, chips, the floating dock, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Under floating glass only (bars, the dock, popups). Cards have none.

tokens.name: glass-tint-light
tokens.usage: Surface tint over the blur for small floating glass (buttons, the dock). Add 0.12 in dark.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Surface tint over the blur for bars, sidebars, sheets with words on them. Add 0.12 in dark.

tokens.name: glass-saturation
tokens.usage: How much colour the blur under glass gains.
